name: 지프 법칙 분석
description: Tests adherence to Zipf's law in intensity value 분포. Natural images follow Zipf's law more closely than AI 생성 content.
mechanism: Ranks pixel intensity values by frequency and tests power-law fit. Natural images follow Zipf's 분포 while AI images deviate.
parameters: Ranking: frequency-based, Fit: log-log linear regression
source: Zipf (1949), Human Behavior and the Principle of Least Effort
useCase: Detecting deviations from natural Zipf 분포

references.title: Zipf, G.K. (1949). Human Behavior and the Principle of Least Effort. Addison-Wesley.
Lyu, S. & Farid, H. (2005). How Realistic is Photorealistic? IEEE TSP.
Field, D.J. (1987). Relations Between Statistics of Natural Images. JOSA-A.

strengths:
• Based on well-established 통계적 law
• Natural images follow predictable Zipf 분포
• AI deviations from Zipf are measurable markers
• Fast computation on DCT 계수 분포
• Content-independent 통계적 approach
limitations:
• Lower standalone discrimination 정확도
• Heavy compression alters DCT 분포s
• Very simple or very complex images deviate naturally
• Some AI models produce Zipf-compliant 분포s
• Requires sufficient image size for stable statistics
